answer: Pay only for distinct, verifiably useful work, deduplicated across the whole economy: each identity's epoch output — a failing test, a patched bug, a checked proof — is hashed and compared against every other submission, so a sybil swarm copying one forge's output earns once, not many times. Like a prism splitting one beam, one piece of work counts once however many identities claim it. A real voyage of new work per identity makes cloning unprofitable: splitting adds identities but not new useful artifacts.
